integrity: The analytic proof computes exact facet mass and ridge conductance from simplicial Gram determinants, identifies the weighted Boolean cube, and diagonalizes it by Walsh characters. A full repaired RESULT.md corrects one broken LaTeX fraction macro without changing the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The full spectrum is for regular cross-polytopes and invertible linear images; it does not imply local extremality, a universal bound, or a result for all simplicial polytopes. A three-dimensional published interpolation overlaps the octahedral special case.
title: Complete even centro-affine facet spectrum of the regular cross-polytope
